text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the lane south of Hartford Avenue, between Herbert Avenue and Elmer Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the lane south of Hartford Avenue, between Herbert Avenue and Elmer Avenue, at the locations as shown on Attachment 1 dated January 2022, attached to the report (April 1, 2022) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
